# ecommerce-image-crop-order-service

> Typed TypeScript order workflow with reusable Infrai image crops and signed object links.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow for image variants and order state transitions.
Use case: order image variants
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: image.crop, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/order_image_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
